easy.statement_latex: For the rational function $f(x) = \dfrac{(x + 5)}{(x + 2)}$, find every vertical asymptote.
hints: Vertical asymptotes occur at zeros of the denominator that are NOT also zeros of the numerator.
Set each factor of the denominator equal to zero and solve. If the same factor appears in the numerator, it cancels and produces a hole instead of an asymptote.

Solve each equation: $x = -2$.
Check that none of these values also zero the numerator (which has zeros at $x = -5$). None cancel, so every denominator zero is a true vertical asymptote.
Vertical asymptotes: $x = -2$.
